summary: Iteration 12 — Daily Intelligence Layer (Iter10) verification: FULL PASS on all 4 requested areas. (1) Dedicated iter10 in-process suite: 27/27 PASS in 0.57s (`tests/test_iter10_daily_intelligence.py`, TestA_AnalyzerPure×15 + TestB_APIEndpoints×8 + TestC_ContextAssemblerFlag×2 + TestD_NoDecisionCreation×2). (2) Combined regression iter8+iter9+iter10 in a SINGLE pytest session (session-scoped shared_client fixture works): 92/92 PASS in 14.15s, zero motor 'Event loop is closed' errors, zero flakes. (3) Live smoke suite `tests/test_iter10_live_smoke.py` (NEW, 13 tests) against https://ora-decision-engine.preview.emergentagent.com with demo@ora.app: 13/13 PASS in 3.68s — TestLiveEndpoints×7 (today shape+all 10 keys, tomorrow==today+1, refresh returns {today,tomorrow}, /date/2027-08-15 is_holiday==true & 'holiday' in signals, /date/nonsense→400, unauthenticated→401, cross-user isolation returns total_events=0) + TestInvariants×5 (decision count unchanged across all daily endpoints hit 2× each; permission_audit contains ZERO events with event_type starting 'notification.'; deterministic output for score/signals/busy_minutes/free_minutes/total_events/is_weekend/is_holiday/is_vacation_day within same second; seeding all-day 'Ferie' via POST /api/life-graph/nodes → is_vacation_day=true & 'vacation' in signals; seeding one status=cancelled + one confirmed for tomorrow → busy_minutes==60 exactly, cancelled skipped) + TestFilesystemInvariants×1 (grep -rEi 'openai|emergentintegrations|gpt|LlmChat' /app/backend/daily_intelligence/ → 0 matches, exit 1). (4) Prior-suite no-regression: Iter9 config-status 11/11 PASS in 1.67s. GRAND TOTAL: 27 + 92 + 13 + 11 = 143 assertions across 4 suite runs, 100% green. Invariants a→i all verified. No product bugs, no leaks, no side effects on Decisions/notifications/ranking/life-graph, no frontend changes.
test_report_links: /app/backend/tests/test_iter10_live_smoke.py (NEW — 13 live+invariant tests hitting the preview URL)
critical_code_review_comments: daily_intelligence/analyzer.py (433 lines, pure functions, no imports of openai/emergentintegrations/gpt/LlmChat): categories, thresholds, and holiday list are hardcoded module-level constants → strictly deterministic given input list. Score is a bounded int, signals/warnings/opportunities are enumerated strings, energy_estimation is {level,score,reasons}. Overlapping events merged in busy computation (test_a8: 9-11 + 10-12 → 180 min, not 240). Cancelled events skipped in analyzer (test_a13 + live spot-check).

daily_intelligence/service.py (115 lines): reads life_nodes filtered by user_id and type=event; NO write operations, NO decision creation, NO notification emission. Cross-user isolation confirmed both in-process (test_b8) and live (fresh user sees total_events=0).

routers/daily.py (42 lines): 4 endpoints, all Depends(get_current_user); GET /date/{iso} raises HTTPException 400 on invalid ISO (test_b6+live test). Refresh returns exactly {'today','tomorrow'} keys.

context_assembler/daily_summary_provider.py (74 lines, flag-gated by DAILY_SUMMARY_ENABLED): with flag OFF the provider appears in provenance.providers_run but emits ZERO signals → context_hash byte-stable across two assemble calls (test_c1). With flag ON emits a daily_summary signal whose value dict contains NO 'title' key (test_c2), only counts/booleans/enums — no event titles leak into ranking.

tests/conftest.py session-scoped shared_client fixture correctly avoids motor 'Event loop is closed' when multiple in-process TestClient-based suites run in the same pytest process. Verified: 92-test combined run completes cleanly.

No file under /app/frontend/, /app/backend/connectors/google_calendar/, /app/backend/decision_engine/, /app/backend/life_graph/ was modified by Iter10 (git-independent check: daily_intelligence is a NEW isolated module + routers/daily.py + context_assembler/daily_summary_provider.py — all additive).

seed_data_creation: One ephemeral registered user per live-smoke module run: iter10_live_<ts>_<hex6>@ora.app via POST /api/auth/register. Used to (a) verify cross-user isolation, (b) seed an all-day 'Ferie' event for today, (c) seed a status=cancelled + a confirmed event for tomorrow. All data is scoped to that ephemeral user; no impact on demo@ora.app or other users. In-process suite creates iter10_a_<ts>@ora.app and iter10_b_<ts>@ora.app (isolated TestClient DB).
